claims.claim: Controller and worker collections use bounded rule/count/SHA-256 identities; conformance rejects missing, malformed, or disagreeing collection data.
Compaction preserves complete canonical phase reports and exact failure nodeids, details, fingerprints, profiles, and toolchains independently of display truncation.

Deterministic regression coverage exercises 8,192 collection items, twelve workers, 24,576 phase reports, and 51 failures. Synthetic pytest and selected-wrapper observations occupy 7,211,087 and 14,404,935 bytes under the unchanged 16 MiB bound.
Cleanup failures preserve primary exceptions and blocking verification outcomes, exposing subordinate diagnostics capped at four entries of 1,024 characters each.
Unrecoverable cleanup without an earlier verification failure raises RuntimeVerificationError; existing finite cleanup retry and deadline behavior remains unchanged.

Committed changes are confined to the eight permitted verification infrastructure and regression files, leaving RepositoryLock, TASK-316 behavior, profile selection, and lifecycle authorities unchanged.
